agencies.name_en: Hebei Department of Ecology and Environment

records.title_zh: 七部门部署京津冀美丽中国先行区建设
records.title_en: Seven departments issue an action plan for the Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei Beautiful China pilot zone
records.summary_zh: 行动方案提出绿色低碳转型等六方面二十二项任务，到2027年区域细颗粒物年均浓度降至33微克每立方米，主要污染物排放和碳排放强度继续下降。
records.summary_en: The plan sets 22 tasks across six areas including green and low-carbon transition. By 2027 it targets annual average PM2.5 of 33 micrograms per cubic metre alongside continued declines in major pollutants and carbon intensity.

records.title_zh: 生态环境部披露京津冀生态协同治理进展
records.title_en: MEE reports progress in coordinated ecological governance across Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei
records.summary_zh: 2024年京津冀细颗粒物年均浓度为36.8微克每立方米，比2014年下降58.7%；三地累计压减钢铁产能超过1亿吨，并形成跨省流域生态补偿和重污染天气联动机制。
records.summary_en: Average PM2.5 in the region fell to 36.8 micrograms per cubic metre in 2024, 58.7% below 2014, alongside steel-capacity cuts, cross-provincial ecological compensation and joint pollution-response mechanisms.

records.title_zh: 京津冀发布清洁空气与低碳转型阶段性数据
records.title_en: Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei present new evidence on clean air and low-carbon transition
records.summary_zh: 北京优质能源占比达到99.5%，天津建成零碳港区，河北累计压减退出炼钢产能1.1亿吨；三地2024年细颗粒物年均浓度较2013年均下降超过六成。
records.summary_en: Beijing reported a 99.5% share of high-quality energy, Tianjin a zero-carbon port area, and Hebei 110 million tonnes of retired steelmaking capacity; PM2.5 fell by more than 60% across all three jurisdictions from 2013 to 2024.
records.source_en: Beijing Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau

records.title_zh: 生态环境部部署京津冀大气污染治理强化措施
records.title_en: MEE plans stronger air-pollution measures for Beijing, Tianjin, Hebei and surrounding areas
records.summary_zh: 2024年京津冀及周边地区细颗粒物平均浓度较2017年下降33.8%，但13个城市仍处于全国后20位；下一阶段将聚焦产业、能源和交通结构调整及区域联防联控。
records.summary_en: Regional PM2.5 fell 33.8% from 2017 to 2024, although 13 cities remained among the national bottom 20; the next phase targets industrial, energy and transport restructuring and coordinated controls.

records.title_zh: 京津冀生态协同机制与绿色转型成效发布
records.title_en: Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei publish results from coordinated ecological governance
records.summary_zh: 三地已建立空气、水环境、执法与统一标准等协作机制，并共同实施区域低碳出行碳普惠核算标准；天津港清洁能源机械占比超过70%，河北55家在产钢铁企业全部达到A级环保绩效。
records.summary_en: The region has built joint mechanisms for air, water, enforcement and standards, and adopted a common low-carbon travel accounting standard; clean-energy machinery exceeds 70% at Tianjin Port and all 55 operating Hebei steelmakers achieved top-tier environmental performance.
records.source_en: Beijing Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau

records.title_zh: 北京发布气候变化适应行动方案
records.title_en: Beijing issues its climate change adaptation action plan
records.summary_zh: 方案提出加强京津冀气候监测预警、风险评估和防灾减灾协同，到2035年建设气候适应型宜居城市群，并提升水资源、能源、建筑、交通和公共健康韧性。
records.summary_en: The plan calls for joint regional monitoring, risk assessment and disaster preparedness, aiming for a climate-resilient urban cluster by 2035 with stronger water, energy, building, transport and public-health resilience.
records.source_en: Beijing Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau

records.title_zh: 京津冀实施统一的低碳出行碳普惠核算规范
records.title_en: Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei adopt a common low-carbon travel carbon-accounting standard
records.summary_zh: 三地共同制定的地方标准明确低碳出行项目边界、减排量计算、监测数据和存档要求，为步行、骑行、公共交通及合乘产生的减排量提供统一核算依据。
records.summary_en: The joint standard defines project boundaries, emissions-reduction calculations, monitoring data and archiving rules for walking, cycling, public transport and ride-sharing activities.
records.source_en: Beijing Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau

records.title_zh: 新型能源体系建设“十五五”规划发布
records.title_en: China issues its 15th Five-Year Plan for a new energy system
records.summary_zh: 规划统筹新能源规模化发展、电力系统调节能力、能源安全与绿色低碳转型，是观察中国未来五年能源结构和技术部署的核心政策文件。
records.summary_en: The plan coordinates large-scale new-energy development, power-system flexibility, energy security and low-carbon transition, making it a central policy document for China's next five years of energy-system development.

records.title_zh: 2025年全球新增电池储能装机108吉瓦
records.title_en: Global battery storage additions reached 108 GW in 2025
records.summary_zh: 国际能源署统计显示，2025年全球新增电池储能装机同比增长40%，磷酸铁锂约占部署量的90%，储能成为增长最快的电力技术。
records.summary_en: IEA data show that global battery storage additions rose 40% in 2025 to 108 GW. Lithium iron phosphate supplied about 90% of deployments, making storage the fastest-growing power technology.

records.title_zh: 2025年全球数据中心用电量增长17%
records.title_en: Global data-centre electricity use rose 17% in 2025
records.summary_zh: 国际能源署指出，人工智能专用数据中心用电量在2025年增长50%；电网接入、供电可靠性、能效和储能配置成为数据中心扩张的关键约束。
records.summary_en: The IEA reports that electricity use by AI-focused data centres rose 50% in 2025. Grid connections, reliable supply, efficiency and storage are becoming critical constraints on expansion.

records.title_zh: 国际能源署发布《能源与人工智能》报告
records.summary_zh: 报告建立全球和区域数据中心电力需求模型，分析人工智能对能源安全、排放、创新和可负担性的影响，并讨论供电、能源与电网配置。
records.summary_en: The report models global and regional data-centre electricity demand and assesses implications for energy security, emissions, innovation and affordability, including options for power supply and grids.
